load_image_from_path: load an image from a file path and return it as a PyTorch tensor with optional resizing
load_depth_image_from_path: load a depth image from a file path and return it as a PyTorch tensor with optional scaling
convert_intrinsic_array_to_matrix: convert a 6-element camera intrinsic array into a 3x3 intrinsic matrix
convert_six_dim_pose_to_transform: convert a 6-element camera pose with angle-axis rotation and translation into a 4x4 transformation matrix
interpolate_camera_poses: interpolate camera poses at new timestamps using spherical linear interpolation for rotations and cubic spline for translations
